verdict.rationale: Offline-first sync is a fair question for a Firebase-like backend with realtime features, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only online realtime channels (Broadcast, Presence, Postgres Changes) and resumable storage uploads. It shows no local write queue, offline persistence, or automatic sync on reconnect.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build offline-capable clients whose local writes sync automatically on reconnect
